name: adsb.fi Open Data API
summary: Free live ADS-B aircraft positions from a community network, ADS-B Exchange v2 compatible, for non-commercial use.
description: Open data API with real-time aircraft state by Mode-S hex, callsign, registration, squawk, military flag, or by point and radius up to 250 NM. Responses match the ADS-B Exchange v2 format. Feeders get an additional snapshot endpoint.

rate_limit.summary: Public endpoints are limited to 1 request per second; requests returning 400, 401, 403, 404 or 429 count against the limit and repeated invalid requests lead to a temporary IP block.

endpoints.summary: Aircraft within a radius up to 250 NM (v2 variant is deprecated)

license.name: adsb.fi open data terms: personal, non-commercial use, cite adsb.fi with a link

agent_notes: Use the v3 lat/lon/dist endpoint; the v2 one has a different format and is deprecated. Stay under 1 request per second, one burst of 429s is easy to trigger. Contact adsb.fi for commercial or higher-rate needs.
caveats: Terms restrict use to personal, non-commercial purposes.
A second request fired within a second returned 429 in one test.

verification.notes: Exact v3 example executed without a key.
